verdict.rationale: mise documents a pluggable backend model in which tools come from package registries (npm, cargo, pipx), GitHub releases or plugins. It can still use asdf plugins, and any tool's backend can be overridden to a third-party vfox plugin (e.g. `vfox:mise-plugins/vfox-php`). Community users confirm the wider set of package sources. missing for 10: documentation on authoring or publishing your own plugins/backends, evidence of installing plugins from arbitrary third-party repositories, and hands-on corroboration of the plugin extension path specifically.
